items.docs:
Submits an NQE query to run asynchronously against a Snapshot of the given Network. Returns an `executionKey`
that identifies the execution for subsequent status and result requests.

params.name: networkId
params.description: The ID of the Network the execution belongs to.

params.name: executionKey
params.description: The `executionKey` returned when the query execution was requested.

items.docs:
Returns the current status of an NQE query execution. When it completes normally, the `outcome` will be `OK` and
the result can then be retrieved using [Get NQE query execution
result](https://docs.fwd.app/latest/api/nqe/get-nqe-execution-result/). When the query has completed with an
`outcome` of `USER_ERROR`, the response includes an `error` that contains the diagnostic output.

params.name: networkId
params.description: The ID of the Network the result belongs to.

params.name: executionKey
params.description: The `executionKey` returned when the query execution was requested.

params.name: offset
params.description:
Zero-based index of the first row to return. Use together with `limit` to page through large result
sets.

params.name: limit
params.description:
Maximum number of rows to return in this response. When omitted, no limit is applied and all
remaining rows from `offset` onward are returned.

items.docs:
Returns the result of an NQE query execution whose `status` is `COMPLETED` and `outcome` is `OK`. The response
contains the rows produced by the query in the `items` property; use the `offset` and `limit` query parameters
to page through large result sets.

An `executionKey` remains valid until the next major release of Forward Enterprise; afterwards,
this endpoint returns a 404 error for that key.

params.name: networkId
params.description: The ID of the Network to query. Required unless the `snapshotId` parameter is provided.

params.name: snapshotId
params.description: An optional Snapshot id. If omitted, the network’s latest processed Snapshot is used.

params.name: before
params.description: The ID for the Snapshot to base the diff on.

params.name: after
params.description: The ID for the Snapshot to diff against the base Snapshot.

items.docs: Identifies differences in the results of an NQE query for two Snapshots of a network.

params.name: dir
params.description:
If specified, include only queries in the given directory. The directory must start and end with a forward
slash, such as `/L3/Advanced/`.
